description: Decode a saved competitor ad into a reusable formula: hook, script, scenes, audio, call to action and style, plus a generation-ready recreation prompt. Requires a quote_id from estimate_ad_cost with kind "decode" (a flat price). Credits are charged only when the analysis succeeds; an ad decoded before returns its stored decode and charges nothing. SIGN-IN REQUIRED: connect this server with OAuth (the host prompts for it), or add an API key header "Authorization: Bearer acd_live_…" created at https://aicontentdrop.com/settings/integrations.

ad_id.description: A saved ad's id, from list_saved_ads or save_competitor_ad.

quote_id.description: The quote_id from estimate_ad_cost with kind "decode". Required.

name: decode_ad

cached.description: True when a stored decode was returned; nothing was charged.

credits_quoted.description: The price fixed by the quote.

credits_used.description: Credits charged: 0 for a stored decode or when the charge could not be applied (then note says so); null when the figure is not reported.

decode.description: The ad's formula, layer by layer, plus a generation-ready prompt.

layers.description: hook { pattern, first2s }, script { skeleton[], tone }, scenes { shotCount, medianCutSec, aspect, timeline[] }, audio { voStyle, pace, musicRole }, cta { pattern, placementSec?, urgencyDevice? }, style { visualElement, palette?, typography?, energy }.

recreationPrompt.description: A 150-300 word prompt that recreates the ad's structure with a different product.

note.description: Present only when the charge could not be applied to the account.

replayed.description: True when this quote_id had already been submitted and the original result was returned.
